response.sql:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_duration,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration > 5
  GROUP BY rating
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_duration) AS overall_benchmark
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT
  ra.rating,
  ra.avg_rate_per_duration,
  ra.film_count,
  ra.avg_rate_per_duration / b.overall_benchmark AS relative_to_benchmark
FROM rating_averages AS ra
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE b.overall_benchmark IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The benchmark averages rating-level averages computed from the films with rental_duration > 5, using equal weight for each rating with a nonmissing average.

alternatives.interpretation: The benchmark uses per-rating averages over all films, while the displayed rating averages and counts still use only films with rental_duration > 5.
